Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1319
Claimant:
Benjamin Vasquez
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
May 18, 2024
First notice of loss received for a low-speed head-on collision. The insured's vehicle and the other vehicle were both
reported as haivng front-end damage, and the claimant, who is represented by counsel, has been identified as the
injured occupant.
August 29, 2024
Polcie report and two independent witness statements confirm the collision occurred as described and that the
claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time. Scene photographs were reviewed and are consistent with the
reported impact.
October 26, 2024
Vehicle damage was inspected and the pattern matches the described frontal impact. No prior damage to the vehicle
is known, and nothing in file records suggests the damage predates the policy coverage start.
December 3, 2024
The driver is named on the policy and coverage is confirmed for the date of loss. The claimant's account of events
has remained the same across every contact to date, including the initial call and the recorded interview.
December 7, 2024
Medical records reflect a wrist fracture, which is a plausible injury for this type of collision. Records also show a small
strain to the same area several years ago that healed fully and was not treated as an ongoing condition.
December 17, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with orthopedic follow-up and physical therapy, and tapered off as the claimant's
range of motion and strength improved. Billing has been reviewed against the treatment notes and appears in line
with the care provided.
January 3, 2025
Based on the current file, the injury and treatment appear consistent with the loss. Counsel has been advised of the
review status, and the file will remain open pending receipt of the final medical bills.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
